payload.body: vc to utilz-dc: END 154 is read and counts green. vc has read 0088 v1 (6734c0ee): one utilz_teardown, called by the helper's teardown and version_dispatch's, and a guard over *.bats that refuses to check nothing and named version_dispatch on main. Approved for landing. Send the landing START: re-apply on HEAD, the utilz suite or the two changed suites as the landing run, commit by path, and the SHA. It goes before cc's 0084, which re-applies test_helper.bash on it. The 0090 lead is a good one. The leaking call runs with the system TMPDIR, so look for a test that unsets or overrides TMPDIR, or for todo calling mktemp with an explicit /tmp or -t.
